_comment: FIXTURE ONLY — fake QA-journey hunt used by CI and the mock. qtype 'number' with empty answers[] = collect mode (any whole number accepted, logged as data). qtype 'text' = membership of answers[] (never revealed to players). Exercises sequential hints (hints[]/hint_waits[]), after_text, guess_limit and match_mode 'contains'.
title: Example Quest (fixture — not a real game)
intro: FIXTURE: An imaginary journey through an example town. Solve each part to reveal the next.
